etsy.title: A-Line Skirt Sewing Pattern PDF, Women's Knee Length Skirt XS-3X, Beginner Skirt with Waistband and Zip, A4 Letter A0
etsy.description:
A classic knee-length A-line skirt with darts, a straight waistband and a back zip. Nested sizes XS to 3X, print at home or at a copy shop.

WHAT'S INCLUDED
• Front (cut on fold), back (cut 2) and waistband pieces
• Nested sizes XS, S, M, L, XL, 2X, 3X (see the size chart image)
• A4 and US Letter print-at-home files with a test square
• A0 copy shop file
• Sewing guide: fabric amounts, step-by-step sewing, fitting tips
• Everything in English AND German (Deutsch): two downloads

GOOD TO KNOW
• No seam allowance included: add 1.5 cm (5/8 in), and 3 cm at the hem.
• Length 58 cm (23 in). Ease: 4 cm at the hip, 1 cm at the waist.
• Drafted with the help of software from a standard size chart. A quick test version is always a good idea.
• Skill level: confident beginner.

DEUTSCH: A-Linien-Rock mit Abnähern, Bund und Reißverschluss, Größen XS–3X, A4/Letter und A0, Nähanleitung auf Deutsch. Ohne Nahtzugabe.

INSTANT DIGITAL DOWNLOAD. PDF pattern only, no physical item will be shipped.
For personal use and small-batch handmade sales. Please don't share or resell the files.

Designed by our small shop, AureliaVenn, with the help of AI tools.
